'''Brandon Xavier Ingram''' (born September 2, 1997) is an American basketball player who most recently played for the [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball]] team at [[Duke University]]. Ingram is considered to be a Top 2 selection for the [[2016 NBA draft]].

==Early life==
Ingram was born on September 2, 1997 in [[Kinston, North Carolina]].  He is the son of Donald and Joann Ingram.  He has an older brother, Donovan, and an older sister, Brittany.  Ingram's brother, Donovan, played basketball at South Plains College (2008–2010) and UT Arlington (2010–2012).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.goduke.com/ViewArticle.dbml?ATCLID=210294990|title=Brandon Ingram Bio|website=goduke.com|access-date=2016-04-18}}</ref>  When Brandon was around 11 or 12 years old, his brother allowed him to play with him and his older friends.  Brandon described this experience as "the best thing that ever happened to my game." By the time he reached eighth grade, ex-NBA star and Kinston native, [[Jerry Stackhouse]], became Ingram's AAU coach and mentored the young basketball player.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.theplayerstribune.com/brandon-ingram-duke-goodbye-letter/|title=Farewell, Duke {{!}} By Brandon Ingram|website=The Players' Tribune|access-date=2016-04-18}}</ref>

Ingram played all four years of his high school basketball career at [[Kinston High School (North Carolina)|Kinston]] (Kinston, North Carolina), and helped lead Kinston to four straight state championships during his time there.<ref>[http://www.kinston.com/sports/local/brandon-ingram-is-the-free-press-player-of-the-year-1.460541?page=1 Brandon Ingram is The Free Press Player of the Year]</ref>  This made Ingram the first men's basketball player to win 4 consecutive North Carolina State Championships in  history.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.goduke.com/ViewArticle.dbml?ATCLID=210294990|title=Brandon Ingram Bio|website=goduke.com|access-date=2016-04-18}}</ref> As a senior he averaged 24.3 points and 10.4 rebounds per game.<ref>[http://www.highschoolot.com/brandon-ingram-to-announce-college-decision-on-monday/14607173/ Kinston's Brandon Ingram picks Duke, ending long recruiting process]</ref>

Following his senior season, Ingram was a participant in the [[2015 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2015 McDonald's All-American Game]], where he scored 15 points and had five rebounds.<ref>[http://www.fayobserver.com/blogs/sports/acc_basketball/acc-basketball-brandon-ingram-performs-well-in-mcdonald-s-all/article_bc5986d8-d8e4-11e4-9ca2-2bee2c7541be.html ACC Basketball: Brandon Ingram performs well in McDonald's All-American Game]</ref>  Ingram went 6-of-11 from the field, and also contributed two steals, one block, and one assist.  He also went 3-of-4 from the free-throw line.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.goduke.com/ViewArticle.dbml?ATCLID=210294990|title=Brandon Ingram Bio|website=goduke.com|access-date=2016-04-18}}</ref>

He also made the Parade All-American team, in his senior season, joining Duke teammate Luke Kennard.  In his senior year, he was also named to the North Carolina Basketball Coaches Association All-District First Team.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.goduke.com/ViewArticle.dbml?ATCLID=210294990|title=Brandon Ingram Bio|website=goduke.com|access-date=2016-04-18}}</ref>

===Recruiting===
Ingram was rated as a five-star recruit and was considered among the best players in his class.<ref>[https://rivals.yahoo.com/southflorida/basketball/recruiting/player-Brandon-Ingram-134659 Rivals.com]</ref><ref>[http://www.courier-journal.com/story/recruiting/2014/05/18/brandon-ingram-kentucky-louisville/9250177/ 5-star F Brandon Ingram interested in Cats, Cards]</ref><ref>[http://www.kentucky.com/2014/07/20/3344829_uk-recruiting-top-prospect-ingram.html?rh=1 UK recruiting: Top prospect Ingram ditches AAU circuit for tourney with home team]</ref><ref>[http://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/recruiting/kentucky/2015/01/17/five-star-wing-brandon-ingram-still-closely-considering-kentucky-basketball-hears-john-calipari-often/21924655/ Recruit Brandon Ingram 'very interested' in UK]</ref><ref>[http://www.charlotteobserver.com/sports/high-school/article13892624.html Elite recruit Brandon Ingram’s attention on 4th title, then decision]</ref> On April 27, 2015 he announced that he would attend and play for [[Duke University]] in the 2015-2016 season.

==College career==
During his freshman year, he was named to the 35-man midseason watchlist for the [[Naismith Trophy]] on February 11, 2016.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Payne|first1=Terrence|title=Naismith Trophy midseason list announced|url=http://www.foxsports.com/college-basketball/story/oklahoma-sooners-buddy-hield-lsu-tigers-ben-simmons-naismith-trophy-35-finalists-021116|publisher=[[Fox Sports]]|date=February 11, 2016|accessdate=February 19, 2016}}</ref>

In 36 games for Duke in 2015-16, Ingram averaged 17.3 points, 6.8 rebounds, and 2.0 assists in 34.6 minutes per game.<ref>[http://goduke.statsgeek.com/basketball-m/seasons/season-stats.php?season=2015-16]</ref> He subsequently earned ACC Rookie of the Year honors and AP All-American honorable mention.<ref>[http://www.dukechronicle.com/article/2016/03/grayson-allen-brandon-ingram-named-ap-all-americans Allen named 3rd team AP All-American, Ingram earns honorable mention/]</ref>

On April 4, 2016, Ingram declared for the [[2016 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Ingram|first1=Brandon|title=Farewell, Duke|url=http://www.theplayerstribune.com/brandon-ingram-duke-goodbye-letter/|publisher=The Players' Tribune|date=April 4, 2016|accessdate=April 4, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Schilken|first1=Chuck|title=Duke's Brandon Ingram declares for the NBA draft|url=http://www.latimes.com/sports/sportsnow/la-sp-sn-duke-brandon-ingram-nba-draft-20160404-story.html|publisher=LA Times|date=April 4, 2016|accessdate=April 4, 2016}}</ref> Ingram is considered a Top 2 selection for the draft.
